findings.summary: Audio and physics optional calls reuse DataLowerer.optionalAccess while retaining their existing result admissions.
Mesh factory, resize and attribute arguments use typed BindingScopes snapshots, including explicit optional sink conversions.
Self-contained scene-node runtime tests reuse runGeneratedProgram; specialized compile-only and linked fixtures retain their requirements.
Node-input setter discovery uses LoweringContext.findNodes.
Mesh range validation uses the shared JavaScript number_is_integer predicate.
Property-animation evaluator lookup uses the shared objectInitializer and propertyInitializer helpers.
Native physics-body projection reuses physics_body_world for owner resolution and retention.
Mutable struct and optional record fields share typed cell materialization without conflating data containers and optional handles.
Stylesheet and host UI rules share an ordered trailing-argument renderer with unchanged defaults.
Closed and retained billboard options share one discriminated descriptor table, including widths, precision and update permissions.
Font-face resolution uses one terminal-result cache and receives complete quoted CSS family lists through the shared native font provider.
Physics native arguments share one typed snapshot tail after their distinct sink conversions.
Vertex-count lowering selects its absence representation once rather than overwriting an initial binding.
Frame post-submit lowering has one dispatch declaration path; the unreachable generic fallback entry is removed.
Audio handler and listener removal share unobserved-completion cleanup.

Geometry getters, raw CPU accessors, physics mesh and heightfield extraction, and gizmo bounds share typed borrowed CPU-stream views. Getters copy only returned streams once and preserve optional presence, independent ownership and index-space distinctions.
SDL interleaved mesh draws retain their pipeline cache until another draw writer or stage invalidates it.
Property-animation bucket probes request non-owning identities without allocating callbacks; stored bucket identities retain traced owners.
Dawn transmission draws use the shared span-backed BorrowedDrawList instead of allocating singleton command vectors.
HUD pixel checks decode the browser image once and each native image once, then examine both labels.
Native canvas tabIndex uses the shared numeric constant constructor.
Direct-only callback binding analysis caches both outcomes by checker, scope and declaration identifier.
Conditional asset selection reuses projectAssetContainer in typed resource lowering for checked singleton-clone projection.
Promise.all and statically expanded collection callbacks carry ordered input provenance into asynchronous activation instead of matching callback parent syntax.
Audio event delivery retains the listener directly in the dispatched closure without an intermediate callback copy.
Audio session destruction and finalization reuse the nonthrowing teardown reporting boundary.
Move mixed mesh/billboard ordering completely into a generated draw plan.
findings.blockedBy: The separate native lists do not retain source deferred-build completion order or prior stable mixed binding order. A unified plan needs those inputs and ordering-neutrality coverage before it can replace the current equal-depth/order and camera-less refusals without inventing behavior.
